description: Manage Datadog host tags. Actions: list (all host tags), get (tags for specific host), add (create tags), update (replace tags), delete (remove all tags). Use for: infrastructure organization, filtering, grouping.

source.description: Source of the tags (e.g., "users", "datadog"). Defaults to "users"

tags.description: Tags to add or set (for add/update actions). Format: "key:value"

name: tags
